subject: DeltaCommerce RFP — eval credit + extension request
messages:
From: Tom Nguyen <tom@deltacommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Retail <procurement@deltacommerce.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: RFP follow-up — request for eval credits and short extension

Hi Marissa,

Quick note following our demo yesterday — thanks for walking us through the latency and cost controls. Our evaluation committee is running a side-by-side against BigModelCo next week (RFP bake-off) and we need to standardize workloads across vendors. Can Redwood support: 1) a 30-day eval sandbox with 150k token credits (usable for generation + embeddings) and 2) a two-week extension on the current pilot window (we're at the end of our initial 14-day window)?

Two constraints from procurement: the sandbox must be logically separated from our prod data and we need a short SLA addendum for data retention (see attached Delta_RFP_SLA.pdf). We'd prefer a conditional top-up if the initial evaluation shows parity on latency/cost.

If possible, procurement wants an informal confirmation today so the panel can schedule the bake-off.

Thanks,
Tom Nguyen
Director of Platform, DeltaCommerce
attachments: Delta_RFP_SLA.pdf (PDF)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: RFP follow-up — request for eval credits and short extension

Team — forwarding Delta's ask. Key points: 150k tokens + 2-week extension, sandbox isolation, retention SLA addendum attached. Delta is running a formal bake-off against BigModelCo next week and procurement needs a quick yes so the procurement window stays open.

Questions for approval ops:
- Can we grant 150k in the hosted eval pool for a dedicated sandbox (isolated tenant)?
- If initial signals look good (latency within 1.2x, cost per token within 1.3x), can we automatic-top up +50k?
- Any legal/security blockers on the retention addendum attached?

I've pasted the procurement contact below so we can loop them once we have an internal OK.

Thanks — Marissa

Subject: Re: Fwd: RFP follow-up — request for eval credits and short extension

Marissa — I can approve a baseline: 150k tokens in a dedicated eval sandbox for 30 days, with the sandbox spun up in our staging VPC (no access to Delta prod by default). Ops notes: we'll mark the workspace as "isolated-eval-DELTA-4592" and enforce KV cache flushing between sessions.

Conditional top-up: I can authorize a manual +50k token top-up (approval via AE + Sales Ops) if telemetry shows:
- 95th percentile decode latency <= 1.2x of the comparator baseline
- effective cost per token within 1.3x

Legal/Security on the retention addendum: Priyom, Neha — quick ask: the attached SLA references 90-day logs removal and a potential audit window. Any immediate red flags? If not, Ops can provision tomorrow morning and I'll grant the credits.

Attachments: MVP_SOW.pdf (ops checklist)

- Ben

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom@deltacommerce.com>, Ava Retail <procurement@deltacommerce.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up — request for eval credits and short extension

Tom / Ava — thanks for the clarity and the SLA doc. Internal team has reviewed and we can proceed with the following binding plan: 

1) Provision: Redwood will create a dedicated sandbox (isolated tenant) for DeltaCommerce: 150,000 token credit, 30-day window starting 2026-12-23.
2) Extension: We'll extend your existing pilot window by 14 days (moving its expiration to 2027-01-06).
3) Conditional top-up: If post-week-1 telemetry meets the thresholds Ben outlined (latency/cost), we'll add 50,000 tokens within 48 hours of the AE + Ops approval.
4) Data & retention: Per the attached Delta_RFP_SLA.pdf, Redwood will keep evaluation logs for up to 90 days; we will provide a short audit report on request within the evaluation period.

Next steps for procurement:
- I've attached the MVP_SOW.pdf (internal ops checklist) and the proposed short DocuSign addendum link here: https://www.docusign.com/rec/XYZ-DELTA-4592
- Marissa — please confirm you want Ops to provision tomorrow morning (12/23). If so, we'll send a provisioning note + account access details and the sandbox credentials to your contact.

Tom, Ava — happy to jump on a 20-min call if you want to walk through the sandbox constraints/metrics we will capture.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Platform Ops, Redwood Inference
